svg.text: Dotnet · D05 · Churn vs roots vs undisposed — prove which one
Gen 0 is cheap. Gen 2 and LOH are not.
Traffic down, heap still up → something still holds it.
Survive → promote. Roots keep you old.
Heap still high after traffic falls = retained refs, not just churn.
GC is not your connection closer.
Rate, retained heap, handles — different fixes.
Ephemeral work should not become Gen 2.
